    SELECT
        r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        r.XCL_088 AS fastest_lap_time,
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)

    WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'Italy'
      AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
),
top_3_italian_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT time_in_seconds
    FROM italian_fastest_laps
    ORDER BY time_in_seconds ASC
    LIMIT 3

    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname
